title: Tiny, cute television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='38' y2='8' stroke='#9aa7ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='62' y2='8' stroke='#9aa7ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='14' y='22' width='72' height='54' rx='9' fill='#5b8def'/>
  <rect x='14' y='22' width='72' height='54' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#a9c4ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='46' height='34' rx='5' fill='#1b2a5c'/>
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='46' height='34' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#7f9bff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- cute face on screen -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='4' fill='#7fffd4'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='44' r='4' fill='#7fffd4'/>
  <path d='M38 53 Q45 59 52 53' fill='none' stroke='#7fffd4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='38' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='45' r='0' fill='none'/>
  <!-- speaker lines -->
  <line x1='69' y1='62' x2='81' y2='62' stroke='#c7d6ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='69' y1='68' x2='81' y2='68' stroke='#c7d6ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='28' y='76' width='12' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <rect x='60' y='76' width='12' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ff8fab'/>
</svg>
